$comment: Vendored subagent extension config (canonical source: ~/.pi/agent/extensions/subagents/). Agent definitions are ambient, not bundled: user-level agents live in ~/.pi/agent/subagents/*.md; this project's agents live in .pi/subagents/*.md. toolExtensions maps a custom (non-builtin) tool name to the extension file that provides it, here the co-located copies in tools/.
